mapper.select: select (case when degree = 1 then '初中' when degree = 2 then '高中' when degree = 3 then '大专' when degree = 4 then '本科' when degree = 5 then '硕士' when degree = 6 then '博士' end) as name, count(*) as value from student group by degree order by value;
mapper.delete: delete from student where id in #{id}
